lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-intensity circular pixel maxima posterior to the gills, consisting of approximately 6-7 vertical columns with 3-5 blobs per column on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible coordinate-like lattice across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (high luminance on the dorsal edge, deep shadow on the ventral edge).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs located within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of small-diameter high-luminance points located on the rostrum and the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, distinct from the larger lateral flank blobs.
